task.title: Validate confirm/approval/two-man tokens + remove bearer-in-audit + scope idempotency by caller
acceptance: confirmToken / X-Confirm-Token is validated against a confirm-token store (issued + not redeemed + bound to command+target+caller)
approvalDecisionId is validated against the governance approval store (exists + not consumed + applies to this command)
twoManSignatureId is validated (two distinct signer operator_ids + bound to command+target)
audit_record no longer persists the caller's raw bearer token
idempotency lookup is scoped by (idempotency_key + operator_id) so cross-user replay is blocked
new test_bff_b1_007_security_hardening covers each rule above
existing test_governance_command_submission and test_command_replay_conflict still pass
